rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the 9-0 coalition together with a narrow, federalism- and fair-notice-sensitive holding that reads “rewarded” to cover deferred quid-pro-quo payoffs rather than standalone gratuities. Kagan is the next most likely author because her surplusage/structure analysis is the opinion’s analytic core, while Thomas or Gorsuch are the most likely to write separately to emphasize original meaning/lenity and limits on federal criminal law.
